feature_notes: Adds canonical style-only mutation without copying cell values, explicit General/date serial export, source number-format derivation retaining other appearance components, and repeatable relationship-resolved stylesheet rewrites. Reuses guarded loaded models after their first transition instead of rescanning all cells for each format edit. Python acceptance covers editable, loaded and write-only format calls and detached aliases; 547 compatibility cases pass. Complete verified 100,000-cell operations are faster and lower-RSS than openpyxl on all three measured modes, with CPU/output/checksum/temp-cleanup evidence. Selected native formula-token and compact-range foundations are also included. Signed/data-only sources, missing stylesheets, unknown style sections and affected unmodeled graphs retain explicit errors. Complete style component APIs, deferred M4 graphs and M5-M7 remain open.
